content.text: Type-check passes. Let me view the final file to confirm correctness.

Fixed: `app/(site)/posts/[slug]/page.tsx` had no `generateMetadata`, so every post used the layout's default title ("tsuzuri"). Added a `generateMetadata` that resolves the same locale-aware translation and sets the tab title to `translation.title` (rendered via the layout's `%s · tsuzuri` template), falling back to the default when the post or translation isn't found.
